responsibility: Implements runtime loading of Xtensa core-configuration data from an optional plugin selected by the XTENSA_GNU_CONFIG environment variable. It wraps dlopen/dlsym (or Windows equivalents), enforces GPL-compatibility checks, reports fatal diagnostics for missing plugins or symbols, and returns either dynamically supplied or built-in definitions for versioned xtensa_config_v1/v2/v3 structures and the exported builtin-definition string list that xtensa.h uses for target feature macros.
